summary: American Clean Resources Group filed an 8-K disclosing a Joint Exploration and Development Agreement with TRG Holdings, LLC for an integrated energy, critical minerals processing, and data center campus on its Millers Hub property in Nevada. The agreement, effective June 9, 2026, has an 18-month initial term and covers geothermal resource assessment, Solar Energy Zone pursuit, and federal land-use authorizations. It includes mutual exclusivity and cost-sharing provisions but does not transfer property interests or establish a definitive joint venture or operating partnership. The agreement is non-binding for commercial terms, with ACE expected to participate in future definitive agreements for energy offtake and data center integration. Watch for further definitive agreements and regulatory approvals from the Bureau of Land Management.
